most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Chronic active Epstein-Barr virus infection presenting as pulmonary arterial hypertension (EBV-associated pulmonary vasculopathy)
one_line_reason: A child with bosentan-refractory precapillary pulmonary arterial hypertension (thromboembolic disease excluded), plus hepatosplenomegaly, thrombocytopenia, low-grade fever, rash, low albumin and mild inflammation, fits the reported picture of CAEBV presenting as PAH better than isolated idiopathic PAH or a connective tissue disease.
